description: Master seeds for DEVELOPMENT runs only. Each master seed drives every random stream in a run through lpcstudy.data.make_rng(seed, *labels). Results produced with these seeds are never confirmatory and are never reported as tests of the pre-registered hypotheses (LPC.PC.7).
